auth.label: JWT Token
auth.description: One-year Amilia JWT sent as a Bearer token. Obtain it by calling POST https://app.amilia.com/api/V3/authenticate with Basic authentication for a dedicated Amilia API user: https://app.amilia.com/apidocs/Index.html#authentication

extraFields.label: Organization Identifier
extraFields.description: Amilia organization number or URL identifier shown in the Amilia store URL and under the organization's account options.

actions.name: get_activity
actions.description: Retrieve one activity from the connected Amilia organization.

showTaxes.description: Whether activity tax details should be included.

activity.description: An Amilia activity object using the fields returned by the organization API.

actions.name: get_program
actions.description: Retrieve one program from the connected Amilia organization.

program.description: An Amilia program object using the fields returned by the organization API.

actions.name: list_program_activities
actions.description: List activities in one Amilia program with visibility, cancellation, occurrence, tax, and pagination options.

showHidden.description: Whether hidden activities should be included.

showCancelled.description: Whether cancelled activities should be included.

showOccurrences.description: Whether each activity should include its full occurrence list.

showTaxes.description: Whether activity tax details should be included.

page.description: The Amilia result page number to request.

perPage.description: The number of Amilia records to request per page.

inputSchema.description: Program identifier, filters, and pagination for listing Amilia activities.

items.description: An Amilia activity object using the fields returned by the organization API.

anyOf.description: The total number of available records when Amilia returns it.

totalCount.description: The total number of available records when Amilia returns it.

anyOf.description: The URL for the next page when Amilia returns one.

next.description: The URL for the next page when Amilia returns one.

outputSchema.description: The normalized Amilia program activity list response.

actions.name: list_programs
actions.description: List programs for the connected Amilia organization with visibility, archive, and pagination filters.

showHidden.description: Whether hidden programs should be included.

showArchived.description: Whether archived programs should be included.

page.description: The Amilia result page number to request.

perPage.description: The number of Amilia records to request per page.

inputSchema.description: Filters and pagination for listing Amilia programs.

items.description: An Amilia program object using the fields returned by the organization API.

anyOf.description: The total number of available records when Amilia returns it.

totalCount.description: The total number of available records when Amilia returns it.

anyOf.description: The URL for the next page when Amilia returns one.

next.description: The URL for the next page when Amilia returns one.

outputSchema.description: The normalized Amilia program list response.
